summary: A mixed legal and business day led by Reliance's $1 billion bond securitization push and rupee weakness to 95.98 against the dollar, alongside three judicial appointments to the Supreme Court and Delhi High Court personality rights consolidation.

bullets.text: Collegium recommends 3 new judges for Supreme Court.
Delhi High Court to decide 3 celebrity personality rights cases together.
Reliance plans second $1 billion bond securitization deal in three weeks.
Rupee weakened 0.2% to 95.9825 against dollar, pressured by crude oil, US yields, equity sell-off.
89% of Meesho Mall's new-to-brand shoppers in FY26 came from smaller cities; Mamaearth acquired 1M+ first-time buyers.
